name: Ornith-1.5-122B
purpose: ornith-ai states: the most capable and efficient member of the Ornith-1.5 family, a reasoning and agentic model for terminal-based coding agents, designed for efficient single-GPU deployment.

license.name: MIT (tag; LICENSE file reported missing for the 35B sibling)
license.notes: Card tag mit and license_link to a LICENSE file; the file could not be fetched (404 on raw/main/LICENSE) 2026-11-19, so the text was not read.

architecture.kind: hybrid DeltaNet + gated attention MoE (qwen35moe family)
architecture.drafter: MTP in a community GGUF name, not verified
architecture.why_this_design: The card of the 122B shares the Ornith-1.5 training description (self-improvement loop over tasks, scaffolds and rollouts); it states no architecture reasons.

variants.notes: community; ornith-ai GGUF repo announced, sizes not published on the card

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from the file size (69.7 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 60 GB; about 14% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from the file size (69.7 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM = 64 GB; about 20% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (69.7 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM = 104 GB; about 31% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (69.7 GB) against the budget of docs/hardware: 29.6 GB VRAM plus 114 GB RAM = 144 GB; about 42% of the file can sit in VRAM, the rest streams from RAM (decode speed depends on that)

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from the file size (69.7 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 12 GB)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from the file size (69.7 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 22 GB)

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from the file size (69.7 GB) against the GPU share of docs/hardware (about 52 GB)

engine_support.notes: same family as Ornith 35B which Tona runs; MXFP4 expert kernels and different shapes would be needed

strengths: Vendor SWE-bench Verified 84.5, above every other open model in this set
weaknesses: Needs an 80 GB GPU for single-GPU BF16; 70 GB at MXFP4
soft.behavior: Reasoning model, think block by default; static YaRN may slightly hurt short inputs.
soft.maturity: New vendor; 9 finetunes and 56 quantizations listed.

tona_fit.reason: Natural top-tier option for the 24 to 32 GB VRAM classes (MXFP4 69.7 GB; vendor SWE-bench Multilingual 76.4) with the same MIT tag as the 35B; no independent number and no license text yet. Out of reach of 16 GB + 64 GB.
blockers: license file missing in the repository
does not fit 16 GB + 64 GB (69.7 GB against about 64 GB budget)

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)

open_questions: Per-language quality and independent coding evidence: the Aider polyglot board is stale (mirrors: last update 2025-11-20, no entry for any model of this database), LiveCodeBench and swebench.com publish no per-language numbers for it that we could retrieve. Check: our own Exercism polyglot run per language.
